name: Balls
original_mechanic: Ball props arc down the column, picking talent targets at spawn, and apply the Juggling status; a Juggling card pays out its column score when it later scores.

name: Column Poker
original_mechanic: While spotlit, every full 5-card band of this card's column is evaluated as a poker hand at scoring.

name: Flames
original_mechanic: Fire props arc down the column applying Burning; a Burning card's suit effect fires with multiplied prop count, and fire cascades can chain within the same act.

name: Hoops
original_mechanic: When a Hoops card scores, hoop props sweep the scored row and re-score every skill card they pass through; talented spawners suppress their own suit effect.

name: Knives
original_mechanic: Knife props launch from the opposite row edge and score plain non-skill prop cards they pass; the spawner also scores itself.

name: Poker Evaluator
original_mechanic: Evaluates each scored line for its best poker hand; only the best poker hand per line pays.

name: Symmetrical Show
original_mechanic: Poker hands are also evaluated on columns in addition to rows.

name: 3 submits per match
original_mechanic: A match consists of 3 submits ('acts'); winning/losing is decided after the 3rd.

name: 5-column board
original_mechanic: Board is 5 columns wide so a full row forms a 5-card poker hand.

name: All-revealed-trigger (earliest)
original_mechanic: Earliest rule: all revealed cards perform their abilities unconditionally.

name: Ball = Juggling status
original_mechanic: Ball drops a Juggling status, which pays out column score when that card later scores.

name: Base four suits
original_mechanic: Standardize on 4 base suits (Knives, Hoops, Balls, Flames) instead of 6, mapping 1:1 to projectile mechanics.

name: Board/deck contract
original_mechanic: The game has a board with 2 zones, a draw deck, a discard deck, and a hidden rule-set deck, which is parsed at game creation to decide board layout.

name: Card anatomy contract
original_mechanic: Every card has a suit, a rank, a stamp slot, a skill slot, and a card type; cards can have 1 parent and 1 child (a stack).

name: Cards enter only via drop
original_mechanic: Cards enter play by dropping automatically from the input row; they cannot be dragged down manually.

name: Column Poker (unnamed)
original_mechanic: Every 5 cards per column are scored as a poker hand.

name: Combo payout formula
original_mechanic: Act payout = row-score x column-score x combo, where combo = 1 + 0.1 x U, and U = number of distinct combo classes (archetype+size+copies) scored this act.

name: Combo per unique effect
original_mechanic: Combo increments by 1 for each unique effect triggered; flat points come from card effects ('cards are ammo'), multiplied by row-combo and col-combo.

name: Combo scoring formula
original_mechanic: Show score = sum of card effect points, multiplied by (1 + row combo) and by (1 + col combo), where row/col combo = number of unique row/column melds scored this submit.

name: Cue via right-click
original_mechanic: Cards are tapped ('cued') via right-click; tappable cards get a glowing halo border that is removed once spent.

name: Deck-click drops loop
original_mechanic: Every click of the deck drops new cards down; a limited number of clicks/rounds are allowed per match.

name: Dual-axis base scoring
original_mechanic: Base scoring combines vertical runs (with a minimum size) per column with horizontal poker hands per row.

name: Fire = Burning status
original_mechanic: Fire drops a Burning status on its target, multiplying that card's own suit-effect prop count.

name: Hidden Rules Deck
original_mechanic: A normally-hidden Rules Deck holds cards that define the default ruleset (stacking, scoring, input/zone counts, draw-on-Next); changing the ruleset means changing cards in this deck.

name: Illegal stack submission spot
original_mechanic: Early rule: an illegal stack could only be placed on the submission spot (removed with the loop v2 rewrite).

name: Knife suit
original_mechanic: Mirrors Hoop but launches from the opposite row side and scores plain (prop) cards instead of talents.

name: Knives/Hoops horizontal projectiles
original_mechanic: Scored knife and hoop cards fly horizontally across their scored row; balls and fire drop down columns.

name: Mancala targeting
original_mechanic: Ball/Fire projectiles are ballistic: a mancala walk down the column picks a fixed count of talent targets at spawn; Fire's eligibility skips talents and other Fire props.

name: Modifier-driven grab/place legality
original_mechanic: Stacking legality is decided by a resolver pass: all cards' allow/deny effects are gathered into a whitelist and blacklist, with the blacklist winning over the whitelist.

name: Per-meld suit firing
original_mechanic: A scored card's suit effect fires once per meld membership (once for its row, once for its column); talented (skill-bearing) cards suppress their own suit effect.

name: Pip comparator resolver
original_mechanic: A pip resolver/comparator class governs all rank/suit comparisons; card mods are asked first (on_compare_ranks/suits) with numeric fallback.

name: Pip-registered scoring methods
original_mechanic: Each pip class can register its own static scoring methods as defaults for that pip; pip effects are permanently active, unlike skills.

name: Poker Evaluator
original_mechanic: Performs best-poker-hand evaluation per line.

name: Projectile hit/miss bonuses
original_mechanic: Gain mult for every hoop passing through an animal or acrobat, every knife missing a stuntsman, every ball hitting a juggler or animal; fire buffs cards it passes through.

name: Prop-vs-feat suit targeting
original_mechanic: Knives reward hitting non-feat (prop) cards, hoops reward hitting feat cards; balls buff feat cards, fire buffs non-feat cards, with balls/fire spreading buffs evenly across the column.

name: Random standard suit roster
original_mechanic: The standard random suit roster is [Hoop, Knife, Ball, Fire]; Firework is excluded from random rolls and instead rises up its column, banking column score at the top.

name: Row-then-column evaluation order
original_mechanic: Evaluation proceeds top-down: poker hands are scored first, with each column's run calculated simultaneously as that row resolves; refined to score all rows first, then all lanes simultaneously at that row.

name: Row x column aggregation
original_mechanic: All vertical (column) scores are multiplied together with all horizontal (row) scores at the end of a submit.

name: Rule cards get random pips
original_mechanic: Rule cards are given a random suit and rank in case a player ever extracts one into normal play.

name: Score slots
original_mechanic: Score slots on the right score whatever is placed on them and double as free spaces between deck clicks.

name: Spotlight rebrand
original_mechanic: Active state is rebranded Spotlight/Focus: a card is 'in the spotlight' when unblocked/topmost; card text gets an icon marking which effects need spotlight and which don't.

name: Symmetrical Show (rule)
original_mechanic: Poker hands are also evaluated vertically, not just horizontally.

name: Trigger order
original_mechanic: Card effects trigger in order: field effects first, then the deck top-down, then the board left-to-right/top-to-bottom (including the input row), then the discard pile top-down.

name: Two-zone board (Entrance/Ring)
original_mechanic: Board has an upper zone (Grand Entrance, where drawn cards wait) and a lower zone (The Ring, where the board is built).

name: Universal deck resolves last
original_mechanic: The Universal (rule) deck is probably applied last in all modifier resolution order.

name: Voucher effects in main deck
original_mechanic: Voucher-type effects (player-side) go in the main deck instead of the rule deck.

name: Whole-board submit
original_mechanic: Player continuously draws to build the board; pressing Submit evaluates and scores the entire board state, then clears it, with Entrance cards dropping down to seed the next board.

name: 3 grids side by side, commit to one
original_mechanic: Each game fills 3 side-by-side 5x5 grids; card effects can influence other grids; player chooses which grid the next 5 entrance cards go into but must commit to a single grid once chosen.

name: 3D stacking as extra rows/cols
original_mechanic: Allow stacking cards on top of each other on the grid, adding a 3D element that functions as theoretical additional rows/columns.

name: 4-coordinate card position
original_mechanic: Every card's position is defined by 4 coordinates: which grid, x, y, and height.

name: 5-wide board for row hands
original_mechanic: A 5-column-wide board allows row-wide poker hands as well as column hands.

name: 5x5 grid entrance placement redesign
original_mechanic: Core redesign: entrance shows top 5 cards as normal, but the player freely chooses where in a 5x5 grid below to place each one.

name: 5x5 grid replaces drop zones
original_mechanic: Replace the 5-6 drop-in zones with a 5x5 grid the player manually places entrance cards into.

name: Any-grid line-completion detector
original_mechanic: A card that detects a new 5-in-a-line completion anywhere across all grids and triggers its scoring.

name: Balanced prop targeting rules
original_mechanic: Alt balance: knives hit non-skill cards and hoops hit skill cards; balls buff skill cards and fire buffs non-skill cards, spreading buffs as evenly across the column as possible.

name: Balls
original_mechanic: Base suit: ball props (count = rank) arc down the column applying a Juggling status that pays out column score when that card later scores; stacking requires different suit and adjacent rank.

name: Base scoring: vertical runs + horizontal poker
original_mechanic: Base scoring is vertical runs (with a minimum size) plus horizontal poker hands.

name: Basic suit props sweep board
original_mechanic: Scored basic (non-skill) cards summon rank-scaled prop objects in their row/column that move across the board and interact with other cards.

name: Board has deck/discard/ruleset zones
original_mechanic: The board has a deck zone, a discard deck zone, and a ruleset deck zone.

name: Cards auto-drop, no manual drag down
original_mechanic: Cards come down on their own and cannot be dragged down manually.

name: Cards have 1 parent/1 child stack
original_mechanic: Cards can have exactly 1 parent and 1 child card, forming a stack.

name: Combo increments per unique effect
original_mechanic: Row/column scoring becomes a combo system: score increments by 1 for each unique effect triggered, with heavier emphasis on card effects that do direct damage under specific conditions.

name: Commit-to-grid entrance rule
original_mechanic: Once the player places a card in a grid, all current entrance cards must be placed in that same grid before the entrance refreshes with 5 new cards.

name: Deck click drop
original_mechanic: Each click of the deck causes new cards to drop down, rounds remaining decrease, and slots on the right score whatever card is put on them.

name: Draw-through then submit
original_mechanic: Constantly draw through the deck like classic solitaire, then submit to evaluate the entire board state and reset.

name: Dynamic input/board card count from rules
original_mechanic: The number of input cards and board cards is decided dynamically at game creation by iterating the rule deck (e.g. a rule dictating 5 input columns and 5 board columns).

name: Effect trigger order
original_mechanic: Card effects trigger in order: field effects, then deck top-down (soon-to-be-drawn first, order hidden), then left-right top-down including entrance, then discard pile top-down (recent discards first).

name: Effect-trigger point gain
original_mechanic: Whenever a card triggers its effect, gain a point.

name: End show early with good entrance
original_mechanic: Entrance cards are global by default; during the final performance, the player can choose to end early if the current entrance cards are good.

name: Entrance cards act via ability
original_mechanic: Entrance/input cards get their draw-and-pass functionality implemented as an ability: on turn start, pass child cards to the board card in the same column, then draw a random card from the deck.

name: Entrance zone cards seed first column
original_mechanic: 5 entrance/input zone cards work as today, refreshing in random draw order once empty or the current grid is full; the 1st input card corresponds to the 1st column of the 5x5 grid.

name: Flames
original_mechanic: Base suit: fire props arc down the column applying Flaming stacks that multiply each burning prop's effect (not applicable to fire-suit or talent cards, but inherited by spawned props); stacking requires different suit and adjacent rank.

name: Flat points multiplied by combo
original_mechanic: Flat points come from scoring, while row combo and column combo values are multiplied into the flat points.

name: Full-stack scoring on tall stacks
original_mechanic: Scoring a height-10 (or taller) stack scores the entire stack at once.

name: Global vs ring-local card effects
original_mechanic: Grid-based card effects can be scoped as global (all grids) or local to a single ring.

name: Grid-creation card owns its zones
original_mechanic: When a 5x5 grid-creation card becomes active it creates the 5x5 zone cards it owns; when inactive, its grid of zone cards is removed and any cards it contains are discarded.

name: Grid-creation rule card
original_mechanic: A rule card that, on game start, checks the deck size and adds one 5x5 grid-creation card to the rules deck per 25 cards in the deck.

name: Grid refill on completion
original_mechanic: If a grid is completed with entrance cards remaining, it frees up for another grid and its empty slots are refilled with the remaining cards in their current slot.

name: Height as a 4th coordinate
original_mechanic: Stacking cards on top of each other adds a 4th coordinate (height); 5 cards aligned in height complete a scorable line at that height, including a same-x,y stack of 5.

name: Height removal drops cards above
original_mechanic: Removing a card from a height stack causes the cards above it to drop down.

name: Height scoring triggers only building up
original_mechanic: Height-based scoring only triggers when a stack builds upward through a multiple of 5; dropping back down through those intervals does not retrigger scoring.

name: Hoops
original_mechanic: Base suit: when a scored Hoops card is untalented, hoop props (count = rank) sweep the scored row and every skill card the hoop passes through scores again; stacking requires different suit and adjacent rank.

name: Immediate vs delayed row/col scoring
original_mechanic: Choice between scoring a completed row/column immediately on completion versus scoring everything at the end; card effects could trigger specifically on completion, rewarding early vs late finishers.

name: Integer numbers (default rank)
original_mechanic: Default rank A-K (1-13), possibly extended to -99..99; negative ranks apply a negative status/shader inverting effects and reducing score, while still counting uniquely toward combo.

name: Match end condition
original_mechanic: Match ends when the deck runs out of cards or the required score is reached.

name: Multiply vertical by horizontal
original_mechanic: All vertical scores are multiplied together with all horizontal scores at the end.

name: New grid per 25/50 deck cards
original_mechanic: A new 5x5 grid is unlocked for every 25/50 cards (tunable) in the starting deck.

name: No submit slot, whole board scores
original_mechanic: There is no special submit slot; the entire board is considered for submission on final score, using entrance cards similar to jokers.

name: Pickup vs legal placement
original_mechanic: A stack can be picked up from anywhere, but if the resulting stack is illegal it can only be placed back on the submission spot.

name: Pip effects permanently active
original_mechanic: Pip effects (suit/rank abilities) should be permanently active, independent of the resolver class.

name: Placed cards are locked by default
original_mechanic: By default, a card placed on an empty grid zone cannot be moved or have cards stacked on it; those actions are reserved for future effects.

name: Poker hand scoring table
original_mechanic: Poker Patience scoring table (UK vs Barry scoring) for pair/two pair/three of a kind/straight/flush/full house/four of a kind/straight or royal flush.

name: Poker Patience base rule
original_mechanic: Poker Patience: lay out 25 cards into a 5x5 square, forming 10 poker hands from the 5 rows and 5 columns.

name: Poker Patience diagonal scoring variant
original_mechanic: Poker Patience variant: also count the 2 longest diagonals for additional scoring.

name: Prop cards defined as feat-less
original_mechanic: Cards without feats (skills) are classified as 'prop' cards.

name: Prop-hits-target mult gain
original_mechanic: Gain mult when a hoop passes through an animal/acrobat card, a knife misses a stuntsman, or a ball hits a juggler/animal; fire buffs cards it passes through.

name: Randomized placement on partial refill
original_mechanic: If the deck cannot refill the entire entrance zone, new card placement is randomized instead of the default left-to-right order.

name: Rarity gates non-null rolls
original_mechanic: Rarity tiers currently gate only whether a stamp/skill/type roll is non-null, based on luck.

name: Re-adding retriggers line scoring
original_mechanic: Removing a card from a completed 5-line and re-adding it retriggers that line's scoring event.

name: Revealed cards act
original_mechanic: All revealed cards perform their abilities.

name: Ring unlocks per 25 deck cards
original_mechanic: Increase the number of grids/rings relative to cards in the deck, e.g. every 25 cards in the deck unlocks a new ring (with a max ring cap to avoid excess).

name: Row/column scoring happens on placement
original_mechanic: Scoring occurs immediately as rows/columns are filled in, rather than on submit; pressing submit/end just fires its own hooks and ends the game without a separate scoring round, and can be pressed at any time.

name: Row-first then simultaneous column scoring
original_mechanic: All row scoring happens first, then all 5 lanes are scored simultaneously with the same per-row scoring repeated for each column, returning scored cards that go through the card-effect loop and get elevated.

name: Row-then-column top-down scoring order
original_mechanic: Submission evaluates top-down, one row at a time and 5 cards at a time, so poker hands score first while runs are calculated per column simultaneously.

name: Rule cards have random suit/rank
original_mechanic: Rule-deck cards carry a random suit and rank in case the player is able to extract them onto the playing field.

name: Ruleset deck parsed at game creation
original_mechanic: On game creation, the ruleset deck is parsed to decide the board layout.

name: Score slot as free space
original_mechanic: The score slot can be used as a free/empty space between deck clicks.

name: Spotlight/focus rename
original_mechanic: 'Active' is rebranded as Spotlight/Focus: cards that are unblocked (uncovered) are in the spotlight.

name: Submit clears and cascades board
original_mechanic: Pressing submit scores everything and clears the board, with upper cards coming down to start a new board state without a full wipe.

name: Suit-specific prop movement
original_mechanic: Knives and hoops move horizontally across their scored row; balls and fire drop down their column.

name: Tips for overscoring
original_mechanic: Scoring is themed as audience excitement with cheering; player gains 'tips' currency for overscoring, playing as the Ringmaster.

name: Unused entrance cards persist
original_mechanic: Unused entrance cards stay in place for the next round rather than being replaced.

name: Vertical poker hands ability
original_mechanic: Ability that makes poker hands also considered vertically (columns), not just rows.

name: Exchange Voucher
original_mechanic: Usable from anywhere (including the deck): cue to swap this card's position with any card on screen.

name: The Fire Marshal
original_mechanic: Town hazard: Flames-suit cards cannot score, and any Flames card in the deck is treated as Wax type this show.

name: The Living Statue
original_mechanic: Gains bonus points at show end for every show it was never moved; any grab resets the bonus to zero.

name: The Tailor's Dummy
original_mechanic: This prop card can never hold a skill, but can hold two stamps.

name: The Vine
original_mechanic: The first time this card would be destroyed or discarded by a fall or hazard each tour, it survives instead.

name: The Wing Walker
original_mechanic: During the Next-phase drop, this card may transfer mid-air from its input column to an adjacent one, chosen on cue before Next.

name: 1 free undo per turn
original_mechanic: 1 free undo is granted per turn by default and does not carry over.

name: 72 Transformations
original_mechanic: A wild card may transform up to 72 tracked times per run; at 72 it ascends into a permanently upgraded form.

name: 8-9-3 jackpot
original_mechanic: Scoring a meld of exactly 8-9-3 pays out a massive jackpot ('the worthless hand').

name: Acrobat (unnamed charge example)
original_mechanic: Has 1 charge; triggers by cue, or auto-spends on Next if unused.

name: Automaton type (Karakuri)
original_mechanic: Acts by itself every Next, performing its cue for free, but can never be manually cued.

name: Avalanche
original_mechanic: After scoring, all cards on the board 'attack the scoreboard,' reducing the goal score by the number of cards on the board.

name: Ban-evasion deck (Hanafuda)
original_mechanic: When a town outlaws a suit, cards in this deck reskin themselves to dodge the ban.

name: Bian lian instant pip-swap
original_mechanic: Instant pip-swap on cue, with the swap method hidden from the player; unlocked via a family-lineage condition.

name: Boss/hazard rule cards
original_mechanic: Temporary negative rule cards that self-destruct after the game/show ends.

name: Bottom Deal
original_mechanic: Draw from the bottom of the deck this turn.

name: Bound pair (Karagöz)
source: DESIGN_REFERENCES.md §A8 Middle East, Central Asia, Mongolia
original_mechanic: Each of a pair gets +mult when placed in opposite zones.

name: Brass Check
original_mechanic: On trigger, mint a Gold card to the top of the deck.

name: Build-to-burn (Las Fallas)
original_mechanic: Invest in a card all tour, then burn it at the finale for a payout proportional to investment; exactly one card can be 'pardoned' from any mass-destruction effect.

name: Buried alive
original_mechanic: Bury a card (remove from game) for N shows; it returns transformed (+rarity) or not at all (small chance).

name: Burst acrobatics (Hopak)
original_mechanic: A Dancer card jumps its whole stack one row in a single cue.

name: Calliope
original_mechanic: +combo for every different class that scored this submit.

name: Cannon dynasty inheritance
original_mechanic: Cannon acts are inheritable between runs, framed as a family dynasty.

name: Canvas
original_mechanic: Sturdy default material for circus-born cards; an upgrade tier above Paper.

name: Card pack node offers
original_mechanic: Nodes offer card packs, or occasionally rarer single cards; packs show at least 1 guaranteed card in the map preview.

name: Cascade Scorer
original_mechanic: Performs the whole-board row/column scoring pass.

name: Censorship-immune puppets
original_mechanic: In towns that ban speech/satire acts, Puppet-type cards perform unhindered.

name: Charivari opening
original_mechanic: Turn-1 bonus for flooding the Ring with many low-rank cards at once.

name: Cheat Day
original_mechanic: Cards remaining in the deck get a rank-up, rewarding winning early with cards to spare.

name: Clever Hans
original_mechanic: Appears to calculate a rank but actually copies its neighbor's value; if the neighbor leaves, it's revealed as rank 1.

name: Clown + companion token
original_mechanic: Comes with a free 1-rank dog token.

name: Column count via rule cards
original_mechanic: Column count is not hardcoded: rule cards (input/zone adders) each add one column at game creation, so effects can add or remove columns.

name: Common (chain)
original_mechanic: Doubles the chance of Rare cards appearing.

name: Dead Man's Hand
original_mechanic: Scoring two pair, aces over eights, triggers a morbid jackpot plus a ghost event.

name: Deck unlocks as gimmick runs
original_mechanic: Deck unlocks double as Balatro-style gimmick runs, unifying two systems into one.

name: Declared jump (Evel Knievel)
original_mechanic: Anchors the Booking system: declare a jump, sell tickets, then attempt to survive it.

name: Dedi's Resurrection
original_mechanic: Restore one destroyed card per show.

name: Default stack legality
original_mechanic: A legal stack is an ascending or descending run; same-suit cards cannot stack.

name: Deus ex machina consumable
original_mechanic: One automatic show-save per run, deliberately framed as feeling like a cheat.

name: Diabolo juggle
original_mechanic: A card is juggled between two columns, alternating position every Next and buffing both.

name: Discard-driven board building
original_mechanic: Discards are a main method of building the board: repeatedly discard Entrance cards until getting what's wanted, then let them drop; an upgrade chain grants more discards or more cards per discard.

name: Discard Joker (unnamed)
original_mechanic: Allows discarding 1 Entrance card per turn; upgradable to more discards or more cards per discard.

name: Double Trigger
original_mechanic: Card's effects trigger twice.

name: Dragon meld
original_mechanic: A scored run moves as one body afterward, relocatable as a unit next turn.

name: Drumroll
original_mechanic: The last meld scored this submit gets +mult.

name: Duende
original_mechanic: A rare emergent state under specific combo/tension conditions triples a card's score with unique presentation; never purchasable, only summoned.

name: Earth / Air / Water / Fire materials
original_mechanic: Elemental materials with custom movement, such as always sitting on top or bottom of a stack.

name: Electric suit (proposed)
original_mechanic: Electric suit buffs cards that are connected/chained together in a certain way.

name: Elemental custom movement
original_mechanic: Elemental card types with custom movement rules, such as always sitting on top or bottom of a stack.

name: Elevate a prop
original_mechanic: Permanently convert one prop card into a feat card.

name: Endless mode unlock
original_mechanic: Finishing the final city wins the run and unlocks endless mode, repeating the final city with guaranteed repeating choices until the player loses.

name: Epic (chain)
original_mechanic: Doubles the chance of Legendary cards appearing.

name: Escaramuza formation bonus
original_mechanic: A synchronized-formation bonus for symmetrical board states.

name: Exchange Voucher
original_mechanic: Usable from the deck: swap it with any card currently on screen.

name: Eye of God
original_mechanic: See all decks (including the rule deck) and their true descriptions.

name: Eye of God true vision
original_mechanic: A prestige unlock grants 'true vision': seeing all decks (including the rule deck) and true card descriptions.

name: Fairy Floss
original_mechanic: When scored, adjacent cards gain +1 rank for this show.

name: Fame improves offer rarity
original_mechanic: Total accumulated fame improves the rarity odds of card offers.

name: Family-tent deck
original_mechanic: Starts weak, but gains a permanent heirloom card each finished tour.

name: Final Act
original_mechanic: Deck-position type: shows up after all other cards are drawn, possibly carrying an extra multiplier.

name: Fire breather
original_mechanic: Projects a Flames buff across an entire row, then Exhausts itself.

name: Fire-knife dual-suit pip
original_mechanic: A pip counting as both Knives and Flames suits simultaneously.

name: Fireworks suit (proposed)
original_mechanic: Fireworks suit directly adds points to its column based on rank.

name: First Act
original_mechanic: Deck-position type: shows up alone, before any other cards are drawn.

name: First of May
original_mechanic: A rookie joins: gain a random Common card with a hidden growth condition that upgrades it after scoring 10 times.

name: First / Second / Final Act (type entry)
original_mechanic: Deck-position control types (see §11 Act types).

name: Flash
original_mechanic: Scores triple points, but only the first time it would ever score, once per show.

name: Flea Circus
original_mechanic: Scores as if it were 5 cards of rank 1, for combo-counting purposes.

name: Flooded rows
original_mechanic: Water-covered rows let cards float (move freely sideways) while the cards beneath stay hidden but active.

name: Fog-of-war route arrows
original_mechanic: Arrow markers stay visible on map edges the player has already scouted.

name: Fool's License
original_mechanic: Ignore one rule card of the player's choice while this card is spotlit.

name: Foot of God
original_mechanic: Switch locations with any card currently on screen.

name: Force-trigger via stacking
original_mechanic: A card that force-triggers a linked on-trigger card whenever it is tapped via stacking; judged probably too hard to implement well.

name: Forward somersault (Con Colleano)
original_mechanic: Flip a card over the one directly above it (swap upward).

name: Genie's Wish
original_mechanic: Choose a card to create a copy of in the player's hand.

name: Ghost Card (summary)
original_mechanic: Doesn't block Spotlight for cards beneath it.

name: Glass
original_mechanic: Scores double points, but is destroyed (shatters) after being scored 3 times.

name: Gold card
original_mechanic: Money-token card; heavy, so it always sinks to the bottom of the deck.

name: Gold suit
original_mechanic: A literal money suit, playable as a normal suit as well as functioning as currency.

name: Gold token cards
original_mechanic: Gold cards are heavy token cards minted by Producer-class effects or money-on-trigger stamps.

name: Grand Spec
original_mechanic: If all columns scored this submit, double the show's combo.

name: Half-step rank
original_mechanic: Rank of 5½ (etc.): stacks between 5 and 6 in a run but can never meld into a poker hand.

name: Hall of Mirrors
original_mechanic: The boss show duplicates the board's reflection with fake copies (Gaffs) of the player's cards to play around.

name: Handicap flourish
original_mechanic: Voluntarily debuff this card's move for double its score.

name: Harlequin pip

name: Two-faction city (Parintins)
original_mechanic: Picking a faction on arrival changes the goal, the shop, and who heckles the player.

name: TypeInput
original_mechanic: On turn start, passes its held child cards to the paired lower column, then takes a random card from the deck.

name: Undo at outcome screen
original_mechanic: Pressing Undo at the win/lose screen dismisses the outcome and rewinds the final Submit.

name: Uniqueness multiplier
original_mechanic: A separate early idea: a multiplier that grows with every unique effect triggered during a submit.

name: Universal placement ability
original_mechanic: A card ability lets any card be placed on top of it, overriding default stacking legality.

name: Unpierceable
source: DESIGN_REFERENCES.md §A8 Middle East, Central Asia, Mongolia
original_mechanic: Knife-suit projectiles pass through this card harmlessly (still counts as a 'miss' for stuntman bonuses).

name: Verse duel (repentistas)
original_mechanic: Alternate 'stanzas' (mini-submits) with a town champion; the first to fail a beat loses.

name: Visible-to-trigger + hidden-trigger stamp
original_mechanic: Abilities must be visible to trigger by default; a stamp lets a card trigger even while hidden/covered; deck triggers surface visually on the deck slot as they fire.

name: Voladores calendar meld
original_mechanic: A hidden ritual meld: 4 cards descending 13 ranks each (4x13=52) grants an end-of-run celestial bonus.

name: Walking Through the Wall
original_mechanic: Move a card through an occupied slot to the other side.

name: Wall of Death
original_mechanic: Adjacent columns score +mult, but cards there take 1 Exhaust debuff per show.

name: Water Torture Cell escape chain
original_mechanic: A card locked under 3 conditions unlocks one per turn, paying out on the full escape.

name: Wax
original_mechanic: Rank slowly decreases each show it shares a column with a Flame-suit card.

name: Wax and Gold
original_mechanic: A card carries two rule texts: the visible 'wax' effect and a hidden 'gold' effect discovered by fulfilling the wax one.

name: White Elephant
original_mechanic: Scores huge points, but each show it remains in the deck it eats 1 Gold card.

name: Whiteface/Auguste pairing
original_mechanic: A Whiteface card issues a cue that an adjacent Auguste card executes 'wrongly,' with a better result.

name: Wildcard Pip (summary)
original_mechanic: Adopts the rank/suit of the card below it.

name: Winter Quarters
original_mechanic: Named meta-hub where prestige currency is spent between runs to prepare the next season.

name: X-Ray Eyes
original_mechanic: While this card is covered (blinded), the player can see all facedown/hidden cards.

name: Zone Adder (lower)
original_mechanic: Adds 1 Ring column per copy in the rule deck.

name: +1 reroll, no-repeat rerolls
original_mechanic: Add +1 reroll per game; for the rest of the game, repeated reroll actions do not give the same results.

name: Accordion pile-matching rule
original_mechanic: Accordion Solitaire: draw a card, create a new pile if it doesn't match the newest pile's top card by suit or rank; can only stack on the newest pile.

name: Acrobatic tap-or-carryover charge
original_mechanic: Acrobatic card has 1 charge triggerable by tap; if unused, the charge carries to the next round.

name: Action-triggered negative events
original_mechanic: Events triggered by player actions, e.g. sacrificing too many talent cards causes a union strike, or having too many cards triggers a tax-evasion penalty losing basic cards.

name: Air material (top of deck)
original_mechanic: Air material type stays on top of the deck.

name: Anything-stacks-here card
original_mechanic: Any card can be placed on top of this card.

name: Ascension debuff cards
original_mechanic: Ascensions: each ascension level adds a chosen negative-effect card to the deck or rules deck, including permanent versions of boss environmental hazards.

name: Audience patience meter
original_mechanic: Audience patience system: moving cards drops patience, triggering unique effects delays the drop, and cards auto-drop when patience hits 0.

name: Balloon type
original_mechanic: Opposite of a heavy card: always rises to the top of the stack.

name: Best Bower
original_mechanic: Wild suit that counts as every suit for melds/flushes and can stack anywhere; if untalented, randomly selects a prop from the entire game to trigger.

name: Bid-before-play mechanic proposal
original_mechanic: Proposed bid mechanic for this game: bet before play to gain extra points for hitting an exact number of melds.

name: Biome-based world/act map
original_mechanic: Game runs on a level/act/world system (One Step From Eden style) traveling through biomes that each affect map generation differently.

name: Blank rank
original_mechanic: Rank effectively 0; always passes stacking rank comparisons but cannot participate in rank-based melds or effects.

name: Boss debuffs as ruleset cards
original_mechanic: Negative boss-battle effects are temporary cards added to the ruleset deck, defined to self-destruct after the game/act.

name: Boss phase every few rows
original_mechanic: Every few rows of the triangle map is a boss phase, visually designed to look like terrain.

name: Bribery/memory-wipe extra life
original_mechanic: Bribery/Memory Wipe card: grants an extra life if a city/show is failed, letting the player keep going as if they had won.

name: Buttons and shops as cards
original_mechanic: All buttons should themselves be cards; e.g. a shop reroll is itself a tappable card on the board.

name: Calculation Solitaire base piles
original_mechanic: Calculation Solitaire: suits don't matter; start with ace/2/3/4 foundation piles, one waste pile each.

name: Calculation Solitaire waste-pile rule
original_mechanic: Calculation Solitaire: cards that don't fit go on a waste pile; only the waste pile's top card can move to a foundation, and only if legal.

name: Canfield foundation build rule
original_mechanic: Canfield Solitaire: foundations build with same suit, ascending rank only.

name: Card debuff statuses
original_mechanic: Debuff status effects on cards: e.g. Exhausted (loses rank at round end if it was on board), plus proposed Cancer and Parasites statuses.

name: Card groups boosted by leaders
original_mechanic: Cards belong to groups, and leader cards can boost the members of their group.

name: Card unlocks: action-based and score-based
original_mechanic: Dual unlock system: some cards unlock from specific in-game actions, others from reaching score/win thresholds; common cards from generic progress, rare cards from genre-specific play.

name: Cards as currency
original_mechanic: Instead of currency, cards themselves are the currency and are traded.

name: Carnival meta shop
original_mechanic: The overall meta shop is themed as a carnival.

name: Cheat Day card
original_mechanic: Cheat Day: cards remaining in the deck get a rank increase.

name: Check scoring in deck/discard
original_mechanic: Scoring should also check cards sitting in the deck and discard pile, not just the board.

name: Circular map / return-to-start
original_mechanic: Alt map shape ideas: circle the map instead of a final city, or require returning to the start after reaching a big enough city.

name: Column card
original_mechanic: Column-type card gives points to its column on score.

name: Common-doubles-rare chain
original_mechanic: Common card: doubles the chance of rares appearing.

name: Constellation tour map, no backtrack
original_mechanic: FTL-style constellation map: cannot backtrack, touring cities to build fame, with environmental hazards and surprise weather.

name: Cribbage phase-1 scoring events
original_mechanic: Cribbage phase 1 scores for: total of exactly 15, pairing the opponent's last card, first card being a jack, or a sequence of 3+ consecutive cards (order-independent).

name: Cribbage phase-2 hand scoring
original_mechanic: Cribbage phase 2: score the played hand for 15-combinations, pairs, runs, 4/5-card flushes, and a jack.

name: Cross-game score carryover
original_mechanic: Scoring done outside the main game (side content) carries over into the next game.

name: Deck unlocks combined with gimmick runs
original_mechanic: Deck unlocks (Balatro-style) combined with gimmick-run variants instead of a separate tab.

name: Deck variants change rules
original_mechanic: Different decks influence the starting deck and rules; decks can be combined and picked up during a run.

name: Digital card cannot be discarded
original_mechanic: Digital card type: cannot be discarded from the board.

name: Disaster card packs
original_mechanic: Disaster-themed card packs appear as choices on the board.

name: Double trigger seal
original_mechanic: Seal: this card's effect triggers twice.

name: Earth material (bottom of deck)
original_mechanic: Earth material type stays on the bottom of the deck.

name: Electricity
original_mechanic: On score (if untalented), scores points based on this card's rank plus the ranks of all orthogonally/diagonally connected electric-suit cards; stacking requires different suit and adjacent rank.

name: Elemental materials
original_mechanic: Elemental card materials: Earth, Air, Water, Fire.

name: Elemental movement types
original_mechanic: Elemental card types have custom movement, such as always staying on top or bottom of a stack.

name: Encounters as mini solitaire games
original_mechanic: Map encounters could be mini solitaire games in their own right.

name: Exchange Voucher card
original_mechanic: Exchange Voucher: a special deck card usable to swap itself with any card currently on screen.

name: Eye of God card
original_mechanic: Eye of God: allows seeing all decks and true (unobscured) card descriptions.

name: Eye stamp shows mini skill art
original_mechanic: Eye stamp allows a card to stay active despite being covered, showing a miniature version of the skill art inside the stamp.

name: Face cards worth 10
original_mechanic: Face cards all count as 10 when adding to a hand total.

name: Fame gate every 10 levels
original_mechanic: Every 10 levels, the player must have a certain fame level to progress to the next stage.

name: Fame improves card rarity odds
original_mechanic: Odds of better-rarity cards increase with total fame.

name: Fifteen (cribbage) talent
original_mechanic: Spotlight ability checks the scoring hand (row or column) for cards summing to 15 for bonus points; alt version melds this card with adjacent neighbors whose ranks sum to 15 with it.

name: Fights only on boss phases
original_mechanic: Fights may be restricted to only happen on boss phases of the map.

name: Final act score multiplier
original_mechanic: The final act gets an extra points multiplier, or each act gets an increasing multiplier.

name: Final-act type
original_mechanic: Final-act card type shows up alone after all other cards are drawn.

name: Fire material (moves up)
original_mechanic: Fire material type moves upward one position per turn.

name: Firework suit column score
original_mechanic: Firework suit directly adds points to its column based on its rank.

name: Fireworks
original_mechanic: On score, the rocket rises its column and banks the column score directly based on rank; alt version has each firework trigger add +1 firework to the next trigger; stacking requires different suit and adjacent rank.

name: First-act type
original_mechanic: First-act card type shows up alone before any other cards.

name: Fog of war on map
original_mechanic: Planned but unimplemented: fog of war limiting map visibility.

name: Fog of war on tour map
original_mechanic: Tour theme with fog of war reducing visibility of further map choices.

name: Foot of God card
original_mechanic: Foot of God: can switch locations with any card on screen.

name: Forbidden click-to-stack solitaire event
original_mechanic: A forbidden solitaire variant where you just click cards to stack them into your hand, possibly used for events.

name: Frankenstein card
original_mechanic: On submission, this card combines with the bottom and top cards into a 3-card merged stack that remains in the submission zone after scoring.

name: FTL-style map with special cards
original_mechanic: Map is FTL-like; each location is marked by a single special card the player collects, which has special effects.

name: Future Sight card
original_mechanic: See the next 5 cards in the deck.

name: Genie wish card
original_mechanic: Genie: make a wish by choosing a card to create a copy of in hand.

name: Gold as money material
original_mechanic: Gold cards act as money/currency.

name: Gold heavy to bottom
original_mechanic: Gold cards are heavy and always sink to the bottom of the deck.

name: Guarantee early entrance cards
original_mechanic: Some way to guarantee that newly chosen cards show up first, or sooner, in the entrance.

name: Guaranteed card in pack preview
original_mechanic: Card packs show at least 1 guaranteed card from the pack in the map preview.

name: Hand of God card
original_mechanic: Hand of God: allows moving cards to any location on the board and reordering cards within a deck.

name: Hearts-style negative-suit boss mechanic
original_mechanic: Boss mechanic where certain suits cause a meld to score 0 or negative if scored.

name: Heavy material
original_mechanic: Heavy card type sinks to the bottom of the deck.

name: Hidden trigger stamp
original_mechanic: Hidden trigger: ability activates even when the card is hidden (covered), unlike default active abilities that need visibility.

name: Hippo card
original_mechanic: When a single card is placed on top of this card, consume it and gain its rank in value (rank wraps around).

name: Hype mechanic doubles fame requirement
original_mechanic: Hype mechanic: choose to double the fame required to defeat the next show in exchange for better goodie odds.

name: Hype-wagering system
original_mechanic: Planned but unimplemented: a hype/wagering system.

name: In-run temporary prestige events
original_mechanic: Events can grant temporary prestige points to allocate mid-run instead of only pre-game.

name: Injury clears if unused
original_mechanic: An injury stack is lost if the card goes through an act without performing.

name: Iron type
original_mechanic: Sinks to the bottom of any stack, respecting physical weight order.

name: King chess card
original_mechanic: King: moves like a chess king, never captures (only swaps with adjacent cards), auto-moves out of check from another chess card on any action, and is worth a ton of points if captured by a chess card.

name: Klondike stacking rule
original_mechanic: Klondike Solitaire: tableau stacks opposite color, one rank lower.

name: Kuroko hat
original_mechanic: This card is unseen: does not block Spotlight beneath it and cannot be targeted by effects.

name: La Belle Lucie stacking rule
original_mechanic: La Belle Lucie: only top cards of each pile are playable, moved to foundation or stacked one rank lower, same suit.

name: Label/Evident rule-visibility card
original_mechanic: A 'Label/Evident' type card announces its ruleset-deck effect as an active effect on the board even when the universal/rules deck itself is not visible.

name: Lane loss on lateral movement
original_mechanic: Moving to the left lane permanently loses access to both right lanes; moving to the middle lane loses both left and right lanes.

name: Leader/champion cards
original_mechanic: Leader/champion cards start the game already on the board (or entrance) and do not leave on submit.

name: Leader flavor debuffs
original_mechanic: Optional leader debuffs, e.g. fear of fire/knives preventing placement on fire/knife cards.

name: Legal stack ascending/descending, no same suit
original_mechanic: Legal stacks are ascending or descending rank order and cannot stack same suit.

name: Legal stacks only, harder over time
original_mechanic: Only legal stacks can be picked up, and moving stacks becomes more difficult with time.

name: Light material
original_mechanic: Light card type rises to the top of the deck.

name: Mana cards instead of mana bar
original_mechanic: Instead of a mana bar, use mana cards similar to MTG; any card can serve as a resource.

name: Map card seeds next entrance
original_mechanic: Clicking a card on the map makes it the first card to appear in the drop-down/entrance area of the subsequent match.

name: Map special squares
original_mechanic: Some map squares are special locations like shops; e.g. all 7s could be shops.

name: Maximum Effort/Exhaust stamp
original_mechanic: Maximum Effort/Exhaust: doubles points (or gives flat points) from this card on score, but only refreshes if the card is not played/scored again on the next show.

name: Merci: shift an obstructing card
original_mechanic: Merci (solitaire cheat): allowed once, to move an obstructing card out of the way.

name: Metagame editing ruleset deck
original_mechanic: Metagame where the player tries to modify the default ruleset deck during a run by adding or removing rule cards.

name: Metashop odds vs required score
original_mechanic: Spending points in the meta-shop to manipulate overall card odds also increases the score required per show.

name: Minesweeper map reveal
original_mechanic: Deck starts fully visible but face-down like Minesweeper; can only click a card adjacent to a face-down card, battling for it and revealing adjacent cards; win by uncovering all cards.

name: Mini-game events with puzzle win-con
original_mechanic: Some events are mini-games where score is not the goal but an alternate puzzle win condition, e.g. trigger an effect 5 times to win.

name: Move-resistant cards
original_mechanic: Some cards can resist being moved.

name: Mulligan entrance cards
original_mechanic: Mulligan incoming cards by clicking them and pressing a discard button.

name: Mulligan entrance via tap
original_mechanic: Card effect that allows mulliganing entrance cards when tapped.

name: Mulligan-style card packs
original_mechanic: Card packs where, instead of choosing cards directly, the player mulligans (rerolls) the pack's results arena-style, with an increasable mulligan count.

name: Mystery Box card
original_mechanic: Mystery Box: at game start, this card becomes a random skill.

name: Null cards
original_mechanic: Null cards take up space on the board and are highlighted on hover to show over the null space.

name: Oh Hell bid-exact-tricks rule
original_mechanic: Oh Hell!: players bid exactly how many tricks they intend to win after seeing their hand, capped at the hand size.

name: Oh Hell scoring rule
original_mechanic: Oh Hell!: 1 point per trick won, plus 10 bonus points for hitting your exact bid.

name: Other chess-piece cards
original_mechanic: Other chess-piece cards can stack anywhere permitted by that piece's chess movement, discarding and taking the place of the card they land on.

name: Patience meter mechanic
original_mechanic: Patience system: idle/non-scoring moves drain a patience meter (patience_max, ships at 3); reaching 0 auto-drops cards; rule cards can raise patience_max via a grant path.

name: Pawn chess card
original_mechanic: Pawn: if stacked on the card above it, swaps places (moves up), or two above if bottommost; if stacked diagonally upward, replaces (captures) that card, discarding it.

name: Per-act injury chance
original_mechanic: Each act/trigger has a chance of creating an injury stack; injury stacks increase the chance of permanent retirement/death.

name: Performance ring score multiplier
original_mechanic: Each 'ring' of 5 rows increases the score multiplier for cards scored within it (1st ring 1x, 2nd ring 2x, 3rd ring 3x, etc.).

name: Permanently-active toggle
original_mechanic: Once activated, an effect stays active for the rest of the game and can no longer be toggled off.

name: Pinochle meld types
original_mechanic: Pinochle: melds include runs (A-K-Q-J-10), marriages (King-Queen), the pinochle meld (J diamond + Q heart), and sets (4 Qs).

name: Player plans tour route length
original_mechanic: Players plan their tour route ahead of time, starting with small tours and unlocking longer routes through more cities as they finish tours.

name: Points increase by layer
original_mechanic: Points scored increase based on the layer/height a card is stacked at.

name: Poker Patience adjacency placement
original_mechanic: Poker Patience variant: each new card placed must be adjacent or diagonal to a previously placed card, so the first card can end up anywhere in the final square.

name: Poker Patience PvP mode
original_mechanic: Poker Patience PvP: one player calls out the next card and both players build their own square with the same cards in the same order.

name: Prestige system reshapes map odds
original_mechanic: Prestige currency from wins can be spent to manipulate the odds of cards/events spawning on the map, or to unlock true-vision (seeing the rule deck and true card descriptions).

name: Rearrange entrance cards
original_mechanic: Player can rearrange incoming/entrance cards before placing them.

name: Repeatable entrance discard gambling
original_mechanic: Repeatedly discard entrance cards until satisfied, then commit them to drop; starts with 1 discard per turn (possibly a joker effect), allowing gambling for a better entrance hand.

name: Retirement requires ability activation
original_mechanic: Cards cannot retire (leave play) until scored or until an ability is activated on them; with no ability, there is no retirement condition.

name: Ringmaster leader card
original_mechanic: Ringmaster: no suit/rank; type makes it start in the entrance like other leaders; stamp lets it always be picked up and placed anywhere with nothing on top; skill keeps it on the board after submission.

name: Rule cards always globally spotlit
original_mechanic: Rule cards are a special card type whose top skill is always globally in the spotlight (active), making them not special from normal deck mechanics otherwise.

name: Rules deck defines next/submit behavior
original_mechanic: Game rules (via the rules deck) determine what the Next and Submit buttons do; different rules decks per scenario, permanently changeable during a run.

name: Rules-in-main-deck variant
original_mechanic: A deck variant where the rule deck is empty and all rules are embedded as cards in the main deck.

name: Score for 15
original_mechanic: Score 2 points for every combination that sums to 15.

name: Score for pair
original_mechanic: Score 2 points for a pair.

name: Score for quad
original_mechanic: Score 12 points for a quad.

name: Score for run
original_mechanic: Score 3-7 points for a run of 3 to 7 cards.

name: Score for triple
original_mechanic: Score 6 points for a triple.

name: Second-act type
original_mechanic: Second-act card type shows up alone after half the deck is drawn.

name: Secret melds via add-to-deck effects
original_mechanic: Secret melds to discover, implemented as cards with hidden on-add-to-deck effects that add new scoring rules.

name: Self-upgrading effect
original_mechanic: An effect that upgrades itself into a better version of itself if the player meets certain conditions.

name: Shared charge system
original_mechanic: All charge-based effects share the same charge system, so anything with charges can gain more or less charge from different sources.

name: Shop buy/sell in cards
original_mechanic: Shop sells cards priced in a stack of cards taken from the player's deck (equivalent value); card packs on the map add cards while the shop removes them; shop can sell packs too; reroll cost increases each use.

name: Show-must-go-on weather hazards
original_mechanic: Negative weather effects are thematized as 'the show must go on'.

name: Sin of Gluttony card
original_mechanic: Sin of Gluttony: a Hippo-type card with no value cap that can be fed from anywhere, including decks, permanently consuming cards without returning them.

name: Sliced Bread card
original_mechanic: On submission, if there is a same-suit card later down the stack, gain a point for each card in between.

name: Status effect array on cards
original_mechanic: Cards carry a status array (dictionary of status-effect name to value) processed by a rule card each turn.

name: Storyteller point carryover
original_mechanic: Storyteller: preserves some points for the next game.

name: Suit-nerfing towns
original_mechanic: Certain towns don't score certain suits at all, e.g. 'knifetown' gives no points for knife scoring, similarly firetown/juggletown/hooptown.

name: Survivor deck
original_mechanic: Survivor deck: each suit represents a resource such as food, water, or a weapon.

name: Tap-to-force-trigger card
original_mechanic: A card that can force a linked on-trigger card to fire whenever it is tapped, likely via stacking.

name: Tour planning system
original_mechanic: Planned but unimplemented: a tour-planning system for choosing a route.

name: Town-specific hazards
original_mechanic: Different towns present different hazards; e.g. performing at a volcano might cause lava hazards.

name: Triangle map holes hold card packs
original_mechanic: The triangle map can have holes that contain card packs instead of individual cards.

name: Triangle map tier choice
original_mechanic: Choose from the next 3 card options, moving the player up a tier of a triangle-shaped map and playing a match, repeating.

name: Trigger in deck seal
original_mechanic: Seal: this card's effect can trigger while still in the deck.

name: Trigger when hidden seal
original_mechanic: Seal: this card's effect triggers even when hidden (covered).

name: Trump Fan Tan wild-suit rule
original_mechanic: Trump Fan Tan: one suit is wild; a wild-suit card taking another card's place forces that card to be played to the wild foundation.

name: Uniqueness multiplier
original_mechanic: A multiplier that increases with every unique effect triggered during a run.

name: Utter Chaos card
original_mechanic: Utter Chaos: becomes a random skill on every 'next' action.

name: Vampire Survivors-style prestige shop
original_mechanic: Prestige points system: each win grants points spendable in a menu to change the odds of cards appearing or to apply debuffs for more points.

name: Water material (moves down)
original_mechanic: Water material type moves downward one position per turn.

name: Water type
original_mechanic: Always flows sideways into the shortest adjacent column.

name: Wild pip random selection
original_mechanic: Wild pip randomly chooses itself from among existing pips on the same board/row/column.

name: Wild pip tracks previous pip
original_mechanic: A Wild pip type tracks and mimics whichever pip it last resolved to.

name: World tour fame ramp
original_mechanic: World tour: build fame across cities before reaching the final city; exceeding a city's score requirement raises the requirement for the next city.

name: Acrobat
original_mechanic: X3 Mult on final hand of round.

name: Ancient Joker
original_mechanic: Each played card of a target suit gives X1.5 Mult when scored; the target suit changes at end of round.

name: Blast Off
original_mechanic: 2 hands and 2 discards per round, 4 Joker slots; includes Planet-card vouchers; hand/discard-boosting vouchers and the Burglar Joker are banned.

name: Blue Stake
original_mechanic: -1 Discard per round.

name: Blueprint
original_mechanic: Copies the ability of the Joker to the right.

name: Bram Poker
original_mechanic: Jokers no longer appear in the shop; starts with an Eternal Vampire Joker and extra Tarot cards.

name: Buffoon Tag
original_mechanic: Gives a free Mega Buffoon Pack.

name: Bull
original_mechanic: +2 Chips for each $1 you have.

name: Canio
original_mechanic: Gains X1 Mult permanently when a face card is destroyed.

name: Cartomancer
original_mechanic: Creates a Tarot card when Blind is selected.

name: Castle
original_mechanic: Gains +3 Chips permanently per discarded card of a target suit; the target suit changes every round.

name: Chaos the Clown
original_mechanic: 1 free reroll per shop.

name: Charm Tag
original_mechanic: Gives a free Mega Arcana Pack.

name: Chicot
original_mechanic: Disables the effect of every Boss Blind.

name: Coupon Tag
original_mechanic: Initial cards and booster packs in the next shop are free.

name: Crimson Heart
original_mechanic: One random Joker is disabled each hand played.

name: Cruelty
original_mechanic: Small and Big Blinds give no reward money; 3 Joker slots.

name: D6 Tag
original_mechanic: Rerolls in the next shop start at $0.

name: Double or Nothing
original_mechanic: All played cards become debuffed after scoring; uses a standard 52-card deck with every card given a Red Seal.

name: Drunkard
original_mechanic: +1 discard each round.

name: Dusk
original_mechanic: Retrigger all played cards in the final hand of the round.

name: Erosion
original_mechanic: +4 Mult for each card below the deck's starting size in your full deck.

name: Ethereal Tag
original_mechanic: Gives a free Spectral Pack.

name: Five-Card Draw
original_mechanic: 6 discards per round, 5 hand size, 7 Joker slots; starts with Card Sharp and a base Joker; hand-size-expanding Jokers are banned.

name: Foil Tag
original_mechanic: Next base-edition shop Joker is free and becomes Foil.

name: Fortune Teller
original_mechanic: +1 Mult per Tarot card used this run.

name: Fragile
original_mechanic: Starts with 2 Eternal Negative Oops! All 6s Jokers; uses a standard 52-card deck with every card given Glass enhancement; all other card-enhancement methods are banned.

name: Garbage Tag
original_mechanic: Gives $1 per unused discard this run.

name: Glass Card
original_mechanic: X2 Mult when scored; 1 in 4 chance to be destroyed after scoring is finished.

name: Gold Seal
original_mechanic: Earn $3 when this card is played and scores.

name: Golden Needle
original_mechanic: Each discard costs $1; 1 hand and 6 discards per round; starts with $10; hand-boosting vouchers and the Burglar Joker are banned.

name: Handy Tag
original_mechanic: Gives $1 per hand played this run.

name: Hit the Road

name: Beggar My Neighbor forfeit rule

name: Beggar My Neighbor pile-win rule

name: Canfield 3-card stock draw

name: Canfield foundation-rank feed

name: Cheat bluff-discard rule
original_mechanic: Cheat: discard face-down while announcing (possibly falsely) what rank you're playing; next player can claim one rank higher, lower, or the same.

name: Cheat call-out resolution
original_mechanic: Cheat: calling 'cheat' makes the accused pick up the whole pile if lying, or the caller picks it up if the accused was truthful.

name: Gin Rummy early-end scoring
original_mechanic: Gin Rummy: a player can end the round early if mostly done with combinations, and is rewarded for having more complete combinations than opponents.

name: Go Fish ask-and-fish rule
original_mechanic: Go Fish: ask another player for a rank you hold; if they have it they hand it over, otherwise you draw ('fish') from stock.

name: Hearts avoid-scoring rule
original_mechanic: Hearts: avoid winning tricks containing hearts (1 point each) or the queen of spades (13 points).

name: La Belle Lucie redeal limit
original_mechanic: La Belle Lucie: three tries to win; redeal reshuffles all cards and redistributes in threes.

name: Mau Mau wildcard/win-call rule

name: Neuner 9s-wild variant

name: Ninety-Nine suit-value bidding

name: Old Maid pair-discard rule
original_mechanic: Old Maid: discard strict pairs from your hand; goal is to not be left holding the queen.

name: President climbing-rank rule
original_mechanic: President: each turn plays equal-or-higher rank or passes; 2s are highest, suit irrelevant.

name: President matched-count play rule
original_mechanic: President: subsequent players must match the number of cards the first player placed, at increasing rank.

name: President Palace hidden-hand variant
original_mechanic: Palace variant of President: play with 3 private cards, 3 face-up cards, and 3 face-down cards, playable only after the previous set is used.

name: President scum tribute rule
